meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会得到一个由 Dial 提供的真实电话号码，能收发短信、接打 AI 语音电话；别人发来或打来的由 Claude 处理，它也能主动用这号码给他人发消息或打电话。
howto.when: 完成技能里的登录并配对手机后，当有人给该号码发短信或打来 AI 语音电话时，Claude 会接待；你也可以让 Claude 用这号码主动联系别人。

say.text: 用我的 Dial 号码给 +1 555-1234 发短信，说‘明天见’。
say.note: Claude 会用这号码发出短信。

say.text: 用我的 Dial 号码给 +1 555-1234 打个电话。

howto.what_en: After setup Claude gets a real phone number from Dial for SMS and AI voice calls; text messages or calls to that number are handled by Claude, and Claude can also proactively use the number to text or call others.
howto.when_en: Once you finish the sign-in and phone pairing described in this skill, Claude answers incoming texts or AI voice calls to that number; you can also ask Claude to use the number to text or call someone.

say_en.text: Send a text to +1 555-1234 from my Dial number saying 'See you tomorrow'.
say_en.note: Claude sends the message using that number.
